deals.description: As part of Albanian Cuisine Month, NOSH Vienna proudly welcomes a special celebration of Albanian gastronomy, where rich culinary heritage meets modern creativity. On November 22nd, we are delighted to host Chef Silvana Musej, joining us from Italy for an exclusive culinary experience that brings a fresh perspective to the flavors and traditions of Albania. With a unique culinary vision, Chef Silvana will reinterpret the essence of Albanian cuisine through contemporary techniques, refined presentation, and creative expression — honoring its roots while exploring new culinary horizons. More than a dining experience, this evening is a celebration of identity, culture, and the stories that connect us through food. November 22, 2026 | 16:30 NOSH Restaurant | Vienna, Austria Proudly hosted in collaboration with Albchef, as part of Albanian Cuisine Month. Limited seating | Reservations required Join us for an unforgettable celebration of Albanian flavors, reimagined.
